- **Stability:** fixed crashes with the particle cannon at the end of its path, at the end of a game while objects are
  cleared away, with units inside a vehicle that turns, and with failing texture or buffer creation; buffer overruns in
  the shadow and sort renderers. Both renderers (Direct3D 11 and Vulkan) rebuild after a lost graphics device, including
  terrain, trees and water. Videos end and loop again, loading loops no longer hang, sounds that are forced to play free
  their voice again.
- **Graphics card:** the game prefers the high-performance graphics card; on computers with more than one, the
  display page of the options menu (or `-adapter`) selects it. Crash reports name the card. Compiled shaders are cached in
  a folder of GZH Neo's own.
- **Shadows:** the old stencil shadow volumes are gone; from Medium on, models cast shadows through the shadow maps,
  and the projected shadows are no longer drawn on top of them. Low on wide screens: the 3D view reaches the bottom
  edge beside the command bar.
- **New AI:** builds attack groups for their target, keeps idle units at posts, retreats and repairs by its forecast of
  a fight, manages power, and takes over the script teams of the classic AI. In 200 test games against the classic
  Brutal AI it won about two thirds.
- **Game logic:** four errors of the original fixed (script condition team, build list around the command centre,
  random values with fractional bounds, nested object type lists). Replays and network games of 2.0-alpha-2 therefore
  do not work with this version.
- **Settings** are limited to tested ranges.
- **Command-line switches in English:** for example `-userData`, `-monitor`, `-rendezvous`, `-testAids`,
  `-settingsReadOnly` (list in BUILD.md); the former German names are gone. Log lines and tool output are English too.
